summary: Flexible content slider displaying cards, images, banners, products, and blocks in combination.
features: Mixed content support (cards, images, banners, products, blocks)
Content area with heading, subline, and button support
shortDescription: The Flexible Content Slider is the most versatile carousel section, capable of displaying any combination of content types in a single slider. Unlike dedicated product or image sliders, it accepts cards, images, banners, products, and custom blocks together. A content area above or beside the slider provides space for headings, sublines, and a call-to-action button. Navigation automatically repositions to bottom when a button is present. Ideal for curated collections mixing different content formats.
